## Vegetation

```{r}
#| label: setup-ndvi
#| include: false

if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/ndxi/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) {
  source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data-loading-ndvi
#| include: false
veg_levels <- c("Barren", "Shrub and Grassland", "Sparse", "Dense")
ndvi <- read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_ndvi_area.csv"))) %>%
    filter(type %in% veg_levels, count > 0) %>%
    mutate(type = factor(type, levels = veg_levels))

```

```{r}
#| label: ndvi-bar
#| results: asis

if (is.null(ndvi) || nrow(ndvi) == 0) print_text(paste_bold("No NDVI file available")) else {

  ndvi_colors <- c(
    "Barren"              = "#cfe4c7",
    "Shrub and Grassland" = "#a5cd9f",
    "Sparse"              = "#82b685",
    "Dense"               = "#2e6a34"
  )

  ndvi_plot <- ggplot(ndvi, aes(x = type, y = percentage, fill = type)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%")),
              vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = ndvi_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(title = paste("Vegetation cover in", city), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor   = element_blank())

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "ndvi-area-bar.png"), plot = ndvi_plot, device = "png",
         width = 8, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(ndvi_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  print_paged_df(ndvi)
}
```
